# Set up marketplace seller onboarding and payouts

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a platform connects buyers and independent sellers or service providers and allocates payments between parties. A reviewed seller-to-payment operating model with tested onboarding, reconciliation and payout exception handling.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Map the parties and flow of funds

agent-runnable


Document the buyer, seller, platform, payment provider and each intended charge, fee, refund and payout. Separate contractual responsibilities from proposed technical account relationships.

- Sources: [Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model](https://docs.stripe.com/connect)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve the marketplace operating model

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Qualified advisers and the provider confirm permitted activities, account responsibilities, verification needs and loss exposure. Pause unsupported jurisdictions or funds flows rather than assuming a processor removes regulatory obligations.

- Sources: [Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model](https://docs.stripe.com/connect)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare seller intake and exception records

agent-runnable


Define required seller evidence, verification status, payout destinations and escalation owners. Design access controls and a private record of changes without storing sensitive seller documents in the open repository.

- Sources: [Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model](https://docs.stripe.com/connect)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Configure the approved account integration

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


An authorized operator configures onboarding, permissions and payment flows in the provider test environment. Use the currently supported integration and protect credentials and bank-account changes.

- Sources: [Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model](https://docs.stripe.com/connect)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Test settlement and failure scenarios

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Finance and engineering verify commissions, refunds, disputes, failed verification and payout failures against sample ledgers. Require approval before enabling a seller whose verification or account status is unresolved.

- Sources: [Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model](https://docs.stripe.com/connect)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Release approved sellers and reconcile operations

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators activate only approved sellers and payment capabilities. Reconcile settlements to seller balances and retain exception ownership; production payouts need their own transaction-specific authorization.

- Verify: A reviewed seller-to-payment operating model with tested onboarding, reconciliation and payout exception handling.
- Sources: [Stripe Connect marketplace account and payment model](https://docs.stripe.com/connect)
